Hi Aisha,

Thanks for the details, and for flagging the Wednesday deadline. You can export your invoices, clients and payments at any time, on every plan, from Settings → Data → Export. Each type downloads as its own CSV file.

Ticking "Include invoice PDFs" adds a PDF of every invoice in a zip file. File attachments on invoices are not included in exports, so those need to be downloaded from each invoice. Exports of more than 5,000 invoices are prepared in the background and emailed to you as a download link within 24 hours, so it's worth starting soon.

The CSV export isn't the only route. The API is available on the Growth and Scale plans, and it can read your full history of invoices, clients and payments with no date limit. Each invoice's PDF is available from the invoice's pdf endpoint.

An account owner creates API keys in Settings → Developers, and the API reference is at developers.ledgerline.example.

Since your finance director is reviewing your tools ahead of the renewal, your account manager can also walk you through your options if that would help.

Best,
Ledgerline Support
